description: This file is the main entry point for a Windows-specific secure environment component in an Android project. It initializes logging, parses command-line flags for pipe paths and TPM usage, validates inputs, and starts the secure environment.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function initializes logging, parses command-line flags, validates required arguments, and starts the secure environment. It returns 0 on success and 1 on failure.
